gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-001 identifies the same compact-open UAT scope error: the prose says AP only on X although the theorem setup and proof use AP approximants on both X and Y.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The compact-open UAT is advertised under AP on X alone even though its construction and proof require AP on both Banach spaces X and Y.

component_coverage.gold_component: The compact-open UAT's stated AP hypothesis omits the required AP on the target space Y.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction explicitly notes the target-space approximating net, concludes AP is needed on both X and Y, and supplies the corresponding prose repair.

gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-005 concerns an unjustified nested finite-rank operator relation being attributed to BAP. It does not identify the separate rank claim for DF(x) and D^2F(x)(h^1,·), nor the zero-rank cases showing that exact rank one is false.
